memory_update.text: AIR is a high-priority underfollowed candidate for the aircraft maintenance/parts/MRO capacity node because it is upstream of airlines and tied to utilization, repair turnaround, and parts availability.
AGYS is a high-priority underfollowed candidate for lodging operations software because hospitality operators may use software to offset labor constraints and operational complexity.

PRSU is a niche public asset-owner candidate for local experience infrastructure, with potential scarcity value in destination attractions and lodges, but needs careful seasonality, leverage, and weather/geography checks.

No clean US-listed pure-play baggage-handling or airport ground-handling contractor was found in this pass; later layers should check ADRs, foreign listings, conglomerate segments, and private-company suppliers such as baggage systems, ground handlers, airport labor vendors, and airport IT contractors.

node: Travel capacity enablers: airport services, baggage handling, maintenance, lodging operations software, and local experience infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expansion found direct US-listed exposure concentrated in aviation aftermarket/MRO, engine leasing and maintenance, hospitality operating software, and destination experience assets. The best underfollowed lane candidates are not airlines or hotels themselves, but companies whose revenue can be pulled by aircraft utilization, hotel/resort complexity, and constrained destination capacity. No clean US-listed pure-play baggage-handling or airport ground-handling contractor was identified in this focused pass; that remains a coverage gap for later searches.
